Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Edward I’s mother was Eleanor of Castile—confusing Edward I’s wife with his mother—despite the Britannica page explicitly indicating Eleanor of Provence as his mother (e.g., “Notable Family Members: … son Edward I”). This misinterpretation of the retrieved evidence led the Planner to direct returning the wrong mother’s name.
